name: MPT Highway Treat Bhimbetka
signature_dish: Highway-stop dal-paneer-paratha lunch near the rock shelters
why_it_matters: MPT Highway Treat sits on NH-46 about half a kilometre from the Bhimbetka Rock Shelters (UNESCO World Heritage, India's oldest prehistoric art — 30,000+ year old paintings). It is the only formal-format restaurant within walking distance of the caves — the building is a restored Indian Railways structure with a maintained garden, three AC rooms upstairs, restaurant on the ground floor. The next nearest options are 15-min drive at Obaidullaganj.
insider_tip: Coach tours pull in 12-2pm; arrive 11am or after 2pm to actually sit down. Paneer pakora and jeera aloo are the two dishes reviewers consistently name. A passing railway track is 100m away — trains add atmosphere or annoyance depending on mood. Open 7am-10pm; the in-house restaurant is the dinner anchor if you're staying overnight in the three rooms upstairs.
signature_address: MPT Highway Treat, NH-46, Bhaiyapur, Raisen District, Madhya Pradesh 464993

name: Bapu Ki Kutia (Bhopal — 46km base)
signature_dish: Pure-veg Bhopal thali (Bhopal-base for a Bhimbetka day-trip)
why_it_matters: Listed as the Bhopal-side anchor for Bhimbetka day-trips: Bapu Ki Kutia opened in 1964 under a palm tree that still stands at the Roshanpura outlet, 61 years old, Bhopal's longest-running pure-veg fine-casual chain. Bhimbetka is 46km south of Bhopal and is most commonly visited as a half-day from the city. Verified Bhopal-side lunch matters more than padding Bhimbetka's thin list with fabricated village-side stalls.
insider_tip: Day-trip pattern: Bapu Ki Kutia early lunch at 11:30am, drive to Bhimbetka (50min via Bhopal-Hoshangabad Road), 90 min walking the rock shelters circuit (10 caves, marked), back in Bhopal by 5pm. Sit under the original palm tree at the Roshanpura branch, not the MP Nagar or Indore franchises.
signature_address: 1, Roshanpura Naka, Beside Rajbhavan Road, TT Nagar, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh 462003

name: Indian Coffee House (TT Nagar, Bhopal — 46km base)
signature_dish: Filter coffee with masala dosa (Bhopal-base for a Bhimbetka day-trip)
why_it_matters: Listed as the Bhopal-side breakfast/snack anchor for a Bhimbetka day-trip: ICH New Market in TT Nagar, the cooperative-run chain whose Bhopal branch retains the white-and-red-turban-server format and the '50s menu. Useful 8-9am before driving south to the caves, or 4pm break on the way back to Bhopal.
insider_tip: Skip 3-4pm — the New Market ICH closes for siesta exactly when most travellers return from Bhimbetka. Order the mutton cutlet from the chalkboard if it's listed — a quiet ICH classic dying out at most other branches. Cash-priority but UPI works.
signature_address: Near Apex Bank, TT Nagar, New Market, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh 462003
